name: trackiq-amazon-rank-readiness
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Rank Readiness
summary: Decides which search terms deserve advertising spend or seeding on a single ASIN, by testing whether a bought organic rank would survive the money stopping — your conversion rate against the market's on the same query. Returns FUND, SEED, TEST or NO-GO per keyword plus a designed HTML report.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

fallback: The bundled scripts only do arithmetic and layout. Without Python, assets/method.md carries every threshold and assets/pulling-data.md the exact pulls, so the same verdicts can be produced by hand as a table.
